reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This candidate authored methodology covers one deliberately restricted new bare railway wheelset architecture: two monobloc steel wheels conventionally cold press-fitted onto cylindrical seats of a solid non-driven steel axle. Its foreground starts with accepted heat-treated wheel and axle blanks, includes actual final machining, interference assembly, joint-curve and geometric acceptance, complete net weighing and factory release. No supplier steelmaking, forging/rolling or heat treatment is silently included. Sources support product families and process interfaces; the exact order drawing and inspection plan establish actual configuration.

Exclude powered/geared wheelsets, hollow axles, resilient/tyred wheels, independent-wheel or variable-gauge arrangements, shrink-fitting, conical seats and high-pressure-assisted fitting; also exclude bearings, axleboxes, brake discs, noise absorbers, final permanent coating/hardening, vehicle manufacture, overhaul, reprofiling and operating rail service. An assembly-only plant buying completely finished wheels/axles cannot claim this final-machining boundary. The category is narrower than CPC49540 and distinct from complete locomotive/wagon manufacture: supplier component state, precision wheel-seat interfaces, two force-position traces and bare-unit acceptance define its material method need. Scientific review remains pending; alignment and mechanical checks do not approve methodology.
reviewed_boundary.covered: New bare non-driven solid-axle two-monobloc-steel-wheel conventional press-fitted wheelsets with actual in-gate final machining
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Other wheelset architectures, standalone wheels/axles, bearing-equipped assemblies, final permanent coating, maintenance and vehicle/service datasets
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New accepted bare wheelset at declared manufacturing release gate

authored_review_metadata.semantic_boundary_decision: Create press-fitted-solid-railway-wheelset, restricted to new bare non-driven two-monobloc-steel-wheel one-solid-steel-axle assemblies with received heat-treated blanks, actual final machining and conventional cold interference fitting on cylindrical seats. Exclude shrink-fit/hollow/resilient/powered/disc/bearing variants, component production and maintenance. No existing material wheelset PCR found; this safety-critical interface, joint trace and final geometry acceptance differs materially from complete locomotive or freight wagon manufacture.
evidence_limitations: Product portfolios support the explicitly selected solid-axle/non-driven/monobloc subset; actual current drawings, approved fit/geometry limits, NDT and original acceptance/weighing records must establish a real order. No universal steel grade, press force, mass, lifetime or empirical range asserted.

BONATRANS2016 article is historical manufacturing-route evidence only. MAE is independent equipment-method evidence, CAF independent product/traceability and alternative-route evidence; manufacturer marketing energy/carbon claims are not adopted.
No actual M, physical quantities or production certificates were obtained. This PCR requires subsequent original foreground acquisition and scientific review, not a completed inventory.

No elementary exchanges are prescribed without an actual documented discharge/withdrawal; real site releases require atomic additions, measurement and identity review before quantitative completeness.
This received-blank-to-bare-wheelset foreground is not complete cradle-to-gate; supplier/energy/treatment links are unresolved.
